Why we exist

A coordination problem, not a marketing problem

Most growing brands do not lack marketing. They lack coordination: a media buyer who never speaks to the creative team, a website the performance numbers never reach, a retention email that goes out a week after the launch it should have supported.

MMC was built to close that gap. Founded in 2019 and based in Thane, Maharashtra, we run performance media, creative and UGC, retention and follow-up, conversion and technology, and brand and packaging as one connected system, under one senior team and one P&L, instead of five separate vendors.

The same team that reads your ad account also briefs your creative, rebuilds your landing page and writes your retention flow, so the work is planned together instead of stitched together after the fact.

How it works

One senior team, every system

Each system does one job. Because the same senior team runs every system, the media, the creative, the site and the follow-up are planned as one thing rather than reported on separately.

    Meta, Google, Amazon and quick commerce run as one account structure, budgeted against contribution margin rather than platform ROAS.

    Retention marketing

  5. 05

    Identity, packaging and design systems that everything else is built on.

Common questions

What people ask about MMC

What is Monday Marketing Company?
Monday Marketing Company (MMC) is an India-based growth partner for D2C, B2B and education brands, founded in 2019 and based in Thane, Maharashtra. It is led by D2C performance marketing.
What are the connected systems?
Performance media, creative and UGC, retention and follow-up, conversion and technology, and brand and packaging. They are run by one senior team under one strategist and one P&L, rather than by five separate vendors.
Who does MMC work with?
D2C brands, B2B companies and educational institutes. D2C is where we go deepest, but the work is not D2C only. Tell us what you run and we will say which approach fits.
What does measured on contribution margin mean?
Contribution margin is the profit left after variable costs. We budget and judge media against it, not against platform ROAS alone, because a platform can report a healthy ROAS on an order that loses money. Read the guide.
Where is MMC based?
Thane, Maharashtra, India. You can reach us through the contact page.
How do we start?
With a free paid-media audit: a call where a senior strategist reads your ad accounts against your break-even ROAS. See how it works.
Does MMC publish pricing or client results?
No. Cost depends on scope and, for media, on ad spend, so we quote after the audit call. We list the services we run for each brand but do not publish per-client results.
